title: Code of Virginia, Title 56 (Public Service Companies), Chapter 10 - Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally
verified_how: fetched https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title56/chapter10/ (HTTP 200): heading 'Chapter 10. Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally' with article headings 'Article 1. Definitions' (s 56-232 Public utility and schedules defined; s 56-233 Service defined), 'Article 1.1. Purchasing Practices' and 'Article 2. Services, Rates, Charges, Etc.' listing s 56-234 (Duty to furnish adequate service at reasonable and uniform rates) in three dated versions, s 56-234.1 (Liability to customer for violation of duty to determine and charge lowest rate applicable), s 56-234.2 (Review of rates) and s 56-235 (When Commission may fix rates, schedules, etc.) onward. I also fetched the title index https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title56/ (HTTP 200): 'Chapter 10 Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally [ss 56-232 through 56-265]'. Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: s 56-234 appears in three dated versions on the register ('Effective until January 1, 2027', 'Effective January 1, 2027, until July 1, 2027', 'Effective July 1, 2027'), so any consumer of this entry must pick the version matching the date in issue. Metering, billing-cycle, arrears and disconnection detail is State Corporation Commission regulation rather than statute; the statute is the enabling and rate-jurisdiction layer.
